sharedTerms.title: All pricing is in US dollars
sharedTerms.description: Website builds use one-time project fees; SEO and advertising are monthly management retainers.

sharedTerms.title: Ad budgets stay in your account
sharedTerms.description: Clients pay advertising platforms directly. We charge separately for management and optimization.

sharedTerms.title: Scope is agreed before work begins
sharedTerms.description: Pages, campaigns, timelines, content responsibilities, revision rounds and any add-ons are confirmed in writing.

sharedTerms.title: Only real deliverables are reported
sharedTerms.description: SEO outreach, earned links and published community shares are reported separately. Rankings, leads and placement approvals are never guaranteed.

sharedTerms.title: Upwork can handle contracting
sharedTerms.description: Projects may be formalized and paid through an agreed Upwork contract; confirm the contract and milestones before work starts.

customProposal: Request a tailored proposal for multiple locations, larger ad budgets, additional web pages or integrated growth services.

categories.eyebrow: Responsive websites with clear deliverables and payment options.
categories.terms: Client provides approved copy, branding and imagery. Hosting, domains, paid plugins, ongoing maintenance and payment processor fees are separate. Growth includes one standard gateway setup (supported plugin or hosted checkout), not full e-commerce development. Advanced payment flows are custom-scoped. 21-49 pages are quoted separately.

tiers.name: Standard
tiers.description: A responsive business website with up to 3 pages.

tiers.name: Business Growth
tiers.description: A complete business website with up to 20 pages.

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.description: 50+ pages, structured discovery and expanded scope.

categories.eyebrow: Search visibility, original content and community promotion.
categories.terms: Each plan covers one website and one business location. On-page work improves existing pages; it does not include building new pages. Community group shares are up-to monthly targets, distributed over the month in relevant groups that allow promotion; group approval is outside our control. Backlinks are earned outreach targets, not guarantees.

tiers.name: Local Essentials
tiers.description: Local search foundations for a growing small business.

tiers.name: SEO Growth
tiers.description: Consistent content, technical improvements and outreach.

categories.eyebrow: Google Ads, Meta Ads and eligible Local Services Ads accounts.
categories.terms: Clients pay ad spend directly to their ad providers. Management fees do not include ad budgets, photography, video production or new landing pages. Google Local Services Ads require eligibility and verification. For LSA, a managed account counts as one channel; campaign limits only apply to platforms supporting campaigns. Spend above a tier cap requires a custom quote.

tiers.name: Ads Starter
tiers.description: Focused management of one paid advertising channel.

tiers.name: Ads Growth
tiers.description: Two channels with regular testing and optimization.
